title: Declining an invitation and suggesting another time
objectives: Decline politely and give a reason
Confirm the plan in a friendly way

courseTemplate.setting: The learner has an early start tomorrow. Saturday afternoon is free.

roles.learner: A friend who cannot go out tonight
roles.partner: A friend inviting the learner to karaoke

courseTemplate.openingLine: We're doing karaoke tonight. Are you in?

targetPatterns.pattern: Thanks for asking, but I have to get up early tomorrow.
targetPatterns.example: Thanks for asking, but I have to get up early tomorrow.

targetPatterns.pattern: How about brunch on Saturday afternoon instead?
targetPatterns.example: How about brunch on Saturday afternoon instead?

targetPatterns.pattern: Count me in. Let me know what time works for everyone.
targetPatterns.example: Count me in. Let me know what time works for everyone.

targetPatterns.pattern: Are you free this Friday? A few of us are getting dinner.

targetPatterns.translation: 周五有空吗？我们几个约了饭。

targetPatterns.pattern: Would you like to join us?

targetPatterns.pattern: I'd love to, but I already have plans.
targetPatterns.example: I'd love to, but I already have plans.
targetPatterns.translation: 很想去，但已经有安排了。

targetPatterns.pattern: Can I take a rain check?
targetPatterns.example: Can I take a rain check?

targetPatterns.pattern: Next weekend works better for me.
targetPatterns.example: Next weekend works better for me.

targetPatterns.pattern: What time and where should we meet?
targetPatterns.example: What time and where should we meet?

targetPatterns.pattern: Feel free to bring someone along.
targetPatterns.example: Feel free to bring someone along.

stages.title: Decline politely and give a reason
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “We're doing karaoke tonight. Are you in?”
successCriteria: The learner can decline politely and give a reason in their own words.
hints: You can start with “Thanks for asking, but …”

stages.title: Suggest a specific alternative
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “No worries. Could we get together another day?”
successCriteria: The learner can suggest a specific alternative in their own words.
hints: You can start with “How about brunch on …”

stages.title: Confirm the plan in a friendly way
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Saturday sounds great. I'll start a group chat.”
successCriteria: The learner can confirm the plan in a friendly way in their own words.
hints: You can start with “Count me in. Let …”

vocabulary.example: Can I take a rain check?
Count me in. Let me know what time works for everyone.
I'd love to, but I already have plans.
The learner has an early start tomorrow. Saturday afternoon is free.
Thanks for asking, but I have to get up early tomorrow.
How about brunch on Saturday afternoon instead?

languageNotes: 拒绝时先给情绪价值（I'd love to, but... / Tempting, but...）再给原因，别只说 "No"；「改天吧」take a rain check 是固定习语。
